activation.note: Activation covers Bun mutating route entries and fetch method branches in non-test source, including pre-existing handlers. Read exclusions and recognised-guard non-findings match the source detector; content-dependent operation and finding facts honestly require new observers. Detector activation checks call presence, not ordering, consistent with the source's detector description.

audit.summary: All 35 segments survive at their claimed destinations, with actionable guard placement, custom-helper guidance, exclusions, and rationale retained. The single obligation is supported by the original fix hint; additions are declared or source-traceable, and no shared-node moves or application-specific overfitting occur.

segmentChecks.note: given retains all four mutating methods and both Bun handler shapes, when makes the obligation apply to every inspected in-scope handler, and then requires the authorisation call in that handler's own body.
The routes-object and fetch-branch forms, the absence of decorators/DI, and ordinary call-based authorisation survive across given, activation, and verifier_detail[4].

verifier_detail[0] retains detection of mutating entries and method guards, brace-matching of the specific body, and reporting when no recognised auth call is present; activation states the corresponding firing conditions.
The broad recognised-call set, absence of a single mandated helper, and instruction to register a project guard rather than suppress the rule are retained in verifier_detail[2] and avoid[1].
then requires a call in the handler body itself, while avoid[0] explicitly rejects reliance on sibling-route or other-handler auth.
prefer[1] preserves both alternatives for an internally authorising wrapper: use a recognised guard name or add the wrapper/project guard to the recognised set.

risks: The recognised guard names and the location of their configuration are not enumerated; a coder using a custom helper must determine how to register it, although the rewrite clearly says to do so rather than suppress the rule.

unobservable: operation=mutating_route_handler_present requires the declared new file-content observer for route entries and method branches.
finding=SECURITY-MISSING-AUTH-001 requires the declared detector-result observer.

review.summary: I agree with the auditor's PASS: the sampled core obligation, detector behaviour, custom-guard guidance, and handler-local-auth requirements are all preserved at their claimed destinations. The coder-facing fields give a clear decision and remediation sequence, and activation is deterministic once its two honestly declared observers are available.
